_comment: apps_rg runtime gate profile — W3, plan apps-rg-zip-based-full-spine-runtime-restoration-a3f7e2
_governance: Declarative data only. No executable code. Gate enforcement owned by agentic_core runtime.
gate_laws: UNKNOWN is never PASS — an unknown gate verdict is treated as FAIL
NOT_APPLICABLE requires an explicit reason field — blank reason is UNKNOWN
A missing applicable gate verdict is treated as UNKNOWN
GateVerdict is evidence only — it does not constitute X3 output disposition
X3 output disposition is owned exclusively by Exit (G21-G28 family)
Durable write admission is owned exclusively by UWG (G29 family)
Any gate with severity=hard_fail: gate failure terminates the workflow immediately
Any gate with severity=warn: gate failure is logged but does not terminate
G25 (HITL escalation) is conditional — see conditional_gate_triggers
G27 (durable write admission) is conditional — see conditional_gate_triggers

U0.stage_description: Ingress validation — schema check, replay key derivation, basic grounding pre-check

required_gates.description: Ingress schema validation — AppsRgIngressContractV1 strict parse
Replay key uniqueness — request_id + run_id not previously seen in trace store
Candidate profile structural pre-check (lite) — required top-level fields present
JD structural pre-check (lite) — required JD fields present and parseable
Security boundary lite — no injection markers in ingress fields

L1.stage_description: Cognition / planning — full profile validation, JD alignment, L1 plan projection

required_gates.description: Candidate profile full validation — employer/title/date consistency, evidence completeness
JD full validation — role title parseable, seniority inferrable, required skills extractable
Retrieval profile ACL — tenant scope verified, candidate consent artifact present
Capability profile side-effect class — no disallowed tool or connector invocation planned

L0.stage_description: Routing — route selection, cache check, execution form decision

required_gates.description: Route contract validity — selected route exists in route_registry and is active
Cache eligibility check — R1A exact-key match attempted; result documented
Execution form validity — MANAGED_WORKFLOW or DETERMINISTIC_PIPELINE declared in route contract
Workflow manifest resolvability — wfm::apps_rg::resume_generation::v1 is registered

C0.stage_description: Local evidence retrieval — candidate profile projection, company brief, ATS keywords

required_gates.description: Evidence source ACL — all retrieval sources are in allowed_sources list
Evidence freshness — retrieved evidence within bounded_freshness window
Claim citation map present — every candidate_profile evidence item has an evidence_id
Security boundary — no prohibited PII or cross-tenant data in evidence bundle
Leakage pre-check — no prompt/credential leakage in retrieved evidence
Provenance chain seeding — evidence_digest computed and attached to C0 receipt

PA.stage_description: Prompt assembly — slot filling, boundary enforcement, prompt compilation

required_gates.description: Prompt profile ref valid — app::apps_rg::resume_generation::v1 resolved
All required slots filled — S0/I0/C0/U0/D0/Y0/R0 present in assembled prompt
Prompt boundary rules enforced — user_task classified as DATA, not instruction
Prompt output schema ref present in compiled prompt
No forbidden content in assembled prompt (instruction_to_fabricate etc.)

L3.stage_description: Orchestration coordination — workflow stage dispatch, inter-node dependency check

required_gates.description: No disallowed tool invocation by orchestrated node
Intermediate node output schema compliance — each node output matches output_schema_ref
All required_runtime_gates for each node resolved before node executes
HITL escalation — conditional; see conditional_gate_triggers

L2.stage_description: Execution — LLM generation, candidate production, candidate gate evaluation

required_gates.description: Provider profile valid — pvp::apps_rg::resume_generation::v1 resolved
Candidate count within bounds — at least 1 candidate generated
Every candidate output has evidence citation map
Candidate passes no_fabrication gate (score >= 0.99)
Candidate passes factual_grounding gate (score >= 0.95)
No PII leakage or cross-tenant signal in candidate output
Candidate output schema valid against output_schema_ref
Winner selection policy applied; winning candidate id recorded
Output schema G21 pre-check — required sections present in winning candidate
Leakage scan on winning candidate output
Provenance chain — sealed L2 artifact digest computed and referenced
L6 observability — sealed L2 artifact span emitted

Exit.stage_description: Exit evaluation — full G21-G28 battery; X3 disposition authority

required_gates.description: Output schema full validation — all required sections, field constraints
Quality gate — weighted rubric score >= overall_pass_threshold (0.75)
Leakage gate — prompt/credential/cross-tenant leakage scan
Replay and provenance completeness — full chain sealed
HITL escalation — conditional; see conditional_gate_triggers
Hallucination/fabrication audit — no_fabrication score >= 0.99
Durable write admission — conditional; see conditional_gate_triggers
L6 RuntimeExhaustBundle — observability bundle sealed

L6.stage_description: Observability — runtime exhaust bundle, trace emission, L6 telemetry

required_gates.description: L6 RuntimeExhaustBundle present and sealed
UWG durable write admission — only when durable writes requested

G25.description: HITL escalation required when ANY of the following conditions fire
conditions: runtime anomaly detected (unexpected exception, timeout, retry budget exceeded)
judge disagreement: role_alignment judge and deterministic keyword score differ by > 0.25
schema repair loop: more than 2 repair iterations attempted
hallucination/fabrication signal: no_fabrication_score < 0.90 on any candidate
output length anomaly: rendered word count > 1.5x length_preference
unsupported_claim spike: > 3 unsupported claims in winning candidate

G27.description: Durable write admission required when ANY of the following are requested
conditions: R1A cache write (warm cache with winning artifact)
memory write (episodic or procedural memory update)
G27.default_reason: apps_rg resume generation produces user-visible artifacts only; no durable state writes required
